programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Cartman er overbevist om at jentene har en dings som kan spå fremtiden, så Butters kler seg ut for å infiltrere deres rekker.

programme.title: South Park: Nitiske ninjaer
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park bestemmer seg for at byen ikke lenger trenger en politistyrke.

programme.title: South Park: Katteorgie (del 1)
programme.desc: Shelley passer Cartman og inviterer kjæresten sin, og Cartmans katt har løpetid.

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Kyle ber Butters i stedet for Cartman til bursdagsfest. Cartman overbeviser Butters om at en meteoritt vil treffe jorden, og gjemmer ham i et tilfluktsrom så han kan gå i stedet.

programme.title: South Park: En drittsekk og en danske
programme.desc: Premiesvinet vil hoppe av presidentvalget.

programme.title: South Park: SPRØYTER!!!
programme.desc: Randy feirer Tegridy Farms' suksess, mens Cartman nekter å bli vaksinert.

programme.title: South Park: Lamslått sommer
programme.desc: På leir med sine udugelige kompiser, går det Jimmy hus forbi at Nathan prøver å drepe ham. Gutta arrangerer en intervensjon når Towelies dopbruk går helt av skaftet.

programme.title: South Park: Helgespesial
programme.desc: Et ubestridelig bånd knyttes mellom en hvit mann og en urinnvåner.

programme.title: South Park: Fåraktig
programme.desc: Mens han er på en gruppeterapitime mot hamstring, blir Stan fanget i en drøm om skolerådgiveren Mr. Mackey.

programme.title: South Park: Streik
programme.desc: Gutta melder Butters på som gjest i et populært talkshow der folk med deformiteter medvirker.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantenning
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park begynner å eksplodere uten forvarsel. Stans far tar saken.

programme.title: South Park: Kassebilderby
programme.desc: Randy og Stan oppdager uforvarende warphastighet, så nå kan Jorden bli opptatt i Det galaktiske planetforbund, men en romgangster truer med å ødelegge alt.

programme.title: South Park: 1%
programme.desc: 99 % rotter seg sammen mot Eric Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny blir oppslukt av det siste nye fra Japan: Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Den siste meksikaner
programme.desc: Da en grensepatruljelek går galt, ender Butters opp med å gjenopplive den meksikanske stoltheten, men Cartman er forberedt på å la leken slutte der.

programme.title: iCarly: Dansende drømmer
programme.desc: iCarly ber fansen om å sende inn videoer av dem selv når de danser sine kuleste danser. Over tre tusen danseklipp kommer inn, og Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver å holde seg oppe hele natten for å se på alle videoene.

programme.title: iCarly: Det spøker på Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie sender iCarly fra en leilighet som det sies at det spøker i. Når det begynner å skje nifse ting, begynner også vennene å bli redde for at spøkelsesryktene er sanne.

programme.title: iCarly: En dag jeg vil angre
programme.desc: Spencer redder livet til hovedsangeren i The Plain White T's og får ham til å gå med på å delta i iCarly. Merkelige ting begynner å gå feil midt i Carlys, Sams og Freddies nettvideosending.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjensittingen
programme.desc: Sam må sitte igjen den kvelden iCarly holder sin 50. nettvideospesialsending. Carly og Freddie kan da altså ikke gjøre som de pleier, så de prøver så godt de kan å få gjennsitting de også, så de kan sende fra skolebenken med Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Fotsår reklame
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie blir invitert til Dakas hovedkvarter, der de blir tilbudt en stor pengesum får å gå god for Dakas nye sko, Tech-foten, på iCarly. Men det viser seg at skoene er forferdelige.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg lover å ikke sladre
programme.desc: Carly får en B på historieprøven hun burde ha fått en A på. Sam, som griper sjansen på sitt ukentlige møte med rektor Franklin, forandrer Carlys karakter på datamaskinen og overrasker henne med A blank.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly redder TV
programme.desc: En prestisjetung produsent vil gjøre iCarly om til et TV-show. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie blir raskt fortvilet når de hører om alle de store forandringene produsenten ønsker å foreta.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg hater Sams kjæreste
programme.desc: Sam får en kjæreste og de to blir uadskillelige. Men når forholdet begynner å få følger for iCarly, forstår Carly og Freddie at de må gjøre noe.

programme.title: iCarly: Overvåket
programme.desc: Etter å ha sett et klipp på iCarly der en mann selger illegale piratkopivideoer, bestemmer to detektiver seg for å bruke Carly og Spencers loft for overvåking.

programme.title: iCarly: Skolebytte
programme.desc: Carly får vite at hun får mulighet til å få et fullt stipend til en privat eliteskole pga nettshowet sitt. Skolen er Briarwood. Carly er i sterk tvil, men Sam og Freddie vet de må få henne til å gå for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Fektedrama
programme.desc: Freddie trenger litt guttetid, så han slår seg sammen med Spencer for å dra og fekte. Freddie er et naturtalent, men ting blir innviklet når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mot den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en date
programme.desc: Når vennen deres Gibby er for sjenert for å be ut jenta han liker, bestemmer gjengen seg for å gjøre ham og hans flamme til deltagere i et "iWin A Date" innslag på nettvideoshowet deres

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så han først
programme.desc: Når Carly og Sam viser interesse for den samme fyren, lover de at han ikke skal komme imellom dem. Men det er vanskelig, og når de slåss om hans oppmerksomhet, blir vennskapet deres satt på prøve.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack rat
programme.desc: Carly må trå til når Spencer blir avhengig av et videospil. Sam lurer Freddie til å tro at han blir forfulgt av uhell når han nekter å sende et kjedebrev videre.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skylder deg en
programme.desc: Sam blir fornærmet når Freddie beskylder henne for ikke å betale ham og Carly noen av de pengene tilbake som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver iherdig å betale dem tilbake - hun finner seg en ordentlig jobb.

programme.title: Made: Prom Queen - Kristy
programme.desc: Kristy McCallan wants to break out of her shy shell and dazzle her doubters by being MADE into a cool and confident Prom Queen.

programme.title: Made: Moto-X
programme.desc: Kaitlin Smith wants to shed her girly girl reputation and find her inner strength by being MADE into a rough and tough motocross racer!

programme.title: Made: Basketball Player
programme.desc: Kenneth is a dancing diva who's determined to gain the acceptance of his military father by being Made into a basketball player.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16
programme.desc: A white horse-drawn buggy (complete with prince) makes Cindy's Sweet 16 a Cinderella fairytale. That is, until her mom dances with her date.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16
programme.desc: A bikini photo shoot, a dress inspired by the movie The Princess Diaries II, and thirty dancers make up Janelle's Quinceanera. Let's hope her diva mother doesn't ruin it!

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16
programme.desc: With the famous R&B singer Gerald Levert as her father, Carlysia gets what she wants. This includes a personal assistant and famous friends.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16
programme.desc: Cher lives in a castle in the small town of Palm Harbor, Florida. Her best friend and mother is a V.I.P. of Saks Fifth Avenue. Cher's Sweet 16 theme is a Mardi Gras masquerade ball because it'll give her party a festive feel.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16
programme.desc: Stephanie is the ultimate perfectionist and everything in her life has to be exactly how she wants it, including her Quinceañera.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16
programme.desc: Amberly, who hails from Virginia Beach, Virginia, has been referred to as the blonde Barbie. The theme for her My Super Sweet 16 party will be "Pink Ice."

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16
programme.desc: Erin is the daughter of the late rap pioneer Easy E and she's throwing the Sweet 16 she knows her famous father would have wanted her to have.

programme.title: My Super Sweet 16
programme.desc: For her entire life, Katie has been pampered like the spoiled southern belle she is. She's never has to lift a finger. Katie is determined to bring Christmas to Memphis with her Sweet 16.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1989 Ford Mustang
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper gjengen fra West Coast Customs Shondas Ford Mustang Convertible. Hun ruller i vei i et pimpet og helt trafikksikkert kjøretøy.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Maxima Station Wagon
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet fra West Coast Customs Ezras Nissan Maxima Station Wagon. Han kjører av gårde i en mobil DJ-bås.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Volkswagen Baja
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet fra West Coast Customs Krissys Volkswagen Baja Bug. Boblen fra 1969 ble konstruert med holdbarhet som mål. Men med sitt bøyde eksosrør og sine ødelagte dører, kan den virkelig beskrives som alt annet enn akkurat det.

programme.title: Sweet Autumn
programme.desc: Maggie, a successful entrepreneur, returns home for a will reading and discovers she’s inherited half of her aunt’s famed maple candy business. What she doesn’t understand is why Aunt Dee’s maple supplier, Dex, inherited the other half. Her return also coincides with the town’s Sweet Autumn Fest, and through a series of letters Aunt Dee left, Maggie and Dex search for the reason behind her aunt’s final wishes. As she and Dex grow closer, Maggie must decide if the life she built is the one she wants.

programme.title: Romantic Rewrite
programme.desc: Ivy is a talented up-and-coming romance book editor, up for a promotion at work but tasked with helping a stubborn mystery writer incorporate romance more successfully into the next book in his best-selling series. When he volunteers to be Ivy’s faux date for her best friend’s beach wedding in return for Ivy’s editing skills, will they be able to rewrite their fake romance into a real one?

programme.title: Here Kills the Bride
programme.desc: Inspired by the Highly Acclaimed Thriller - The Perfect Bride – Jessica is shocked to find out that her brother, Carlos, is getting married in a week to Grace, a girl he just met in a strip club, something he would never regularly do. Determined to find out the real reasons behind the marriage, Jessica gets pulled into a whirlwind of events, putting her own life at risk. Is Carlos in trouble? Or is Grace a victim?

programme.title: All for Love
programme.desc: When an engaged romance novelist is teamed with a Navy man as research for her latest book, she is taken aback by his boisterous personality and egotistical nature. However, as her research brings them closer together, she discovers there’s more to him than meets the eye. Will she choose the man she thought she loved or the real-life embodiment of her fictional hero?

programme.title: Blow Out
programme.desc: A Philadelphia sound-effects man witnesses and records a car accident that turns out to be a politically motivated murder.

programme.title: The Messenger
programme.desc: Den kritikerroste prisvinneren The Messenger er en sterk og intens skildring om en hjemvendt krigshelt som gjør sitt første skritt mot et normalt liv.

programme.title: The Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Oberst Terry Childers (Samuel L. Jackson) har fått i oppdrag å beskytte den amerikanske ambassaden i Yemen mot demonstranter. Situasjonen blir raskt truende og Childers beordrer at mennene hans skal åpne ild mot demonstrantene.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Etter å ha bodd i Afrika har Cady ingen anelse om hvor 'vilt' ting kan bli i sivilisasjonen før hun møter en av de slemmeste artene som finnes, 'Dronningbien', som på denne skolen er den kule og kalkulerende Regina George.

programme.title: The Last Stand
programme.desc: Sheriff Owens er en mann som har slått seg til ro med å bekjempe det lille som er av kriminalitet i den søvnige grensebyen Sommerton Junction.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: En tidligere elite agenten tar på seg et dobbelt oppdrag: å redde en kinesisk jente som har blitt bortført av Triaden, deretter bruke en sikker kombinasjon for å overliste den russiske mafiaen, korrupte NYC tjenestemenn, og Triaden selv.

programme.title: The Shanghai Job
programme.desc: En utbrent sikkerhetsagent for et privat selskap får i oppdrag å eskortere en verdifull kinesisk antikvitet fra Shanghai. Men på veien møter han på standhaftige problemer.

programme.title: Lev Sterkt
programme.desc: I "Lev Sterkt" får kombinasjonen av gaterace og alkohol fatale konsekvenser da Nikolaj og hans beste venn Martin med gassen i bunn dreper ei unge jente. Martin havner i fengsel, og Nikolaj går fri.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Den tekkelige skolejenta Vee Delmonico er lei av å se livet fra sidelinjen, så vennene kan lett overtale henne til å ta en utfordring i det populære nettspillet "Nerve".

programme.title: The Model
programme.desc: Filmen 'The Model' handler om den unge, danske fotomodellen, Emma, som kjemper for det store gjennombruddet i den parisiske moteverden.

programme.title: Lindell: Drømmefangeren - Del 1
programme.desc: Drømmefangeren er en uutholdelig spennende kriminalroman der de psykologiske undertonene bærer handlingen fremover, til det hele ender i et dramatisk kappløp med en iskald morder. Hvem er kikkeren som står i vinduet og betrakter de unge kvinnene i leiligheten vis á vis?

programme.title: Borkmanns Punkt
programme.desc: Et sted det ute gjemmer det seg en morder som gradvis kjenner seg mer og mer sikker. Kaalbringen, en liten kystby, er lammet av skrekk. Maardam også. På kort tid har de to småbyene blitt rammet av to brutale mord. Når og hvor skal Halshuggeren slå til igjen?

programme.title: Pearls And Pigs
programme.desc: Hirvonen og hans fire sønners ulovlige spritforretning, sender faren i fengsel, og nå er guttene overlatt til seg selv i den utdøende småbyen Joensuu.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: Året er 1944 og jødene i Øst-Europa blir massakrert i tusenvis. Oppildnet til handling etter sin kones død, blir den ungarske advokaten Sonson stående i spissen for et motangrep mot de stadig mer desperate og farlige nazistene.

programme.title: Lonely Hearts
programme.desc: Lonely Hearts, en rystende saga om seriemordere på rømmen, er basert på drapene begått av Martha Beck og Raymond Fernandez på slutten av 1940-tallet, og rollen detektiv Elmer C. Robinson spilte da de to ble fanget, fengslet og til slutt henrettet.

programme.title: The Samaritan
programme.desc: Enhver fengselsdom kan sones, men fortiden kan du aldri unnslippe! Etter tyve år bak murene øyner den småkriminelle Foley endelig muligheten for en ny start.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: Den kompromissløse og forførende kunstneren Ingrid forgifter kjæresten sin i et anfall av sykelig sjalusi. Hun idømmes livsvarig fengsel og hennes 15-årige datter Astrid blir deretter kastet rundt mellom ulike fosterhjem.

programme.title: Thanks for Sharing
programme.desc: Adam, Mike og Neil er tre menn som har lite til felles på overflaten, men de er alle sexavhengige i samme støttegruppe i New York. Adam har levd i sølibat i fem år men vurderer å gi slipp på alt da han møter den sexy fitnessfanatikeren Phoebe.

programme.title: Anna and the Apocalypse
programme.desc: Julepynt og bjelleklang, musikalsang og zombieapokalypse. Midt i julestrien trues småbyen Little Haven av en nær forestående undergang. Anna og vennene hennes bestemmer seg for å bekjempe zombiehordene – men hvem kan man stole på i en verden som faller sammen?

programme.title: Madness in the Method
programme.desc: I håp om å få slutt på bare være kjent som 'Jay fra Jay and Silent Bob', slår Jason Mewes seg sammen med filmskaperen Kevin Smith for å skaffe seg en bok som skal lære ham til å bli en seriøs og respektert skuespiller. Men denne boken ender med å snu livet til Jason og hele Hollywood helt på hodet.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Charlie Mortdecai er en sjarmerende kunstkjenner og livsnyter med dyre vaner. Han går med på å hjelpe den britiske etterretningstjenesten MI5 med å finne et stjålet maleri, som sies å gjemme på koden til en svimlende sum gjemte nazi-millioner...

programme.title: Serena
programme.desc: Året er 1929, og det nygifte paret George og Serena Pemberton reiser til Smokey Mountains i North Carolina, hvor de planlegger å bygge opp et tømmerimperium. George har allerede bodd i skoghuggerleieren lenge nok til å ha gjort en lokal jente gravid, men Serena er ny i fjellene.

programme.title: Griffin & Phoenix
programme.desc: Når Griffin får diagnosen om at han har dødelig kreft bestemmer han seg for å ta livet i egne hender og ha det litt moro før han dør. Samtidig som tiden er i ferd med å ebbe forelsker han seg også i Phoenix - som også har en hemmelighet.

programme.title: I Still Believe
programme.desc: En du elsker kan forandre livet. Ett liv kan forandre verden. Fra skaperne av ‘I Can Only Imagine' kommer en tidløst inspirerende kjærlighetshistorie. Gjenoppdag kjærlighetens under i "I Still Believe", basert på den sanne historien om hitlåt-musikeren Jeremy Camp.

programme.title: En Jul Som Betyr Noe i Familien.
programme.desc: Julen er alt annet enn vanlig når tre søsken fra et nytt hjem ikke er enige. Ved hjelp av magi bytter de kropp og kan ikke skifte tilbake- før de lærer å tilbringe høytiden som en kjærlig familie.

programme.title: Tolv Julehunder
programme.desc: En enkefar sender datteren til tanten sin i en by som har forbudt med hunder. Når hun beholder en valp, blir hun inspirert til å hjelpe hundene- og sjarmere borgermesteren med tidenes mest minneverdige juleforestilling.

programme.title: Jule Harmoni
programme.desc: En talentfull sanger og låtskriver blir knust når hennes berømte musikerkjæreste slår opp med henne rett før høytiden. Hun drar tilbake til hjembyen for å gjenoppdage musikk, romantikk, familie og julens magi.

programme.title: Santa Who?
programme.desc: Den ekte julenissen ramler ut av sleden og utvikler hukommelsestap. Han møter snart en utbrent TV-reporter, og reporteren blir hans eneste håp om å få hukommelsen tilbake i tide for å redde julen.

programme.title: Nøtteknekkeren Søt
programme.desc: Silberhaus-barna gleder seg til feiringen på julaften- når gudfaren deres gir dem en tidlig julegave, en nøtteknekker,- som fører til en kamp mellom lekesoldater. En forferdelig tropp med mus ledet av musekongen.

programme.title: Hope Springs
programme.desc: Arnold and Kay have been married for 30 years, and have drifted apart. To save their marriage, they attend an intense, week-long counseling session to work on their relationship.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Peeples
programme.desc: A wealthy family find their idyllic holiday interrupted when a young man visits to propose to their daughter.

programme.title: A Royal Corgi Christmas
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a prince and an American trainer as they scramble to tame a mischievous royal Corgi by Christmas.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's a Madea Christmas
programme.desc: Madea serves up her own brand of Christmas Spirit when she gets coaxed into joining a friend and her family in the country for the holidays.

programme.title: Autumn in New York
programme.desc: Den fremgangsrike restauranteieren Will Keane fyller snart 50, og lever et bekymringsfritt ungkarsliv. Når han møter Charlotte Fielding, en selvstendig ung kvinne, forventer han nok en rask og enkel romanse. Men ingenting blir lett. Og akkurat når Will skal fortelle Charlotte at han ikke kan love "for alltid", tar hun ordene ut av munnen hans. Hun har bare ett år igjen å leve.

programme.title: Bite The Bullet
programme.desc: Bite The Bullet is an epic Western adventure featuring an amazing award-winning cast...

programme.title: Far from Home
programme.desc: Former child star Drew Barrymore had her first teenage role in this offbeat thriller with comic overtones.

programme.title: Vice
programme.desc: VICE foregår i et fremtidsunivers hvor forretningsmannen Julian Michaels (Bruce Willis) har skapt et eksklusivt feriested. Her er det mulig å betale for å leve ut sine fantasier – også de voldelige og seksuelt fordervede – på 100% menneskelignende roboter. Ved en feiltakelse, oppnår en av androidene (Ambyr Childers) selvbevissthet og bestemmer seg for å ta hevn, men hun er fanget i kryssilden mellom Julians leiesoldater og en politimann (Thomas Jane), som er fast bestemt på å få stoppet volden, en gang for alle.

programme.title: The Shanghai Job
programme.desc: The Shanghai Job

programme.title: All The Pretty Horses
programme.desc: Always wanting to live the cowboy lifestyle, young John Grady sets off for a Hacienda in Mexico...

programme.title: Cowboy
programme.desc: Tempers flare and fists fly in Cowboy, an action classic based on the real-life adventures of a cattleman...

programme.title: The Mountain Men
programme.desc: Charlton Heston and Brian Keith star in this film about the closing days of the fur-trapper era of the wild...

programme.title: Cowboy Up
programme.desc: Cowboy Up is a celebration of the risk-taking, daredevil personalities of modern rodeo.

programme.title: The Man From Laramie
programme.desc: An intensely satisfying drama of rugged primitive justice, THE MAN FROM LARAMIE marked the final, and finest, collaboration of one of the most important teams in Western films.

programme.title: Alvarez Kelly
programme.desc: This is the story of a renegade adventurer, Alvarez Kelly who gets caught in the middle of the Civil War...

programme.title: Sniper (1993)
programme.desc: Tom Berenger is a bush-savvy Marine who teams with a political marksman (Billy Zane) to eliminate a Colombian drug lord in the jungles of Central America.

programme.title: Sniper 2
programme.desc: On one last mission, Thomas Beckett is sent into a remote, war-torn wasteland between Eastern Europe and Western Asia to assassinate a repressive terrorist leader. Once the mission is accomplished, Beckett and his spotter, Cole, find escaping more difficult than anticipated. In order to save their lives, Beckett and Cole must weave their way through burnt-out cities and desolate landscapes.

programme.title: Sniper 3

programme.title: When good intentions backfire SPECTACULARLY
programme.desc: After their recent break away from the kids to ‘disconnect and reconnect’ Abbey and Pete are back with tales of when even the best of intentions can backfire with hilarious results. Thailand in the depths of monsoon season? Sounds like the perfect opportunity for Abbey to tear through three books and avoid talking to Pete at all costs… In our weekly whine (or shine) club, we hear from a couple who have had the picture perfect proposal in nowhere else than the big apple itself as well as a woman who is convinced her husband has taken up whistling as a full time hobby just to drive her round the bend. And we also hear some outrageous chat which will hopefully stand as a warning to all you guys on why you shouldn’t drunk and dial. On this week’s Therapy Crouch we’ve got 99 problems but a b*tch aint one. Enjoy!

programme.title: Wedding Planning
programme.desc: On today’s episode, we get an exclusive invite to the planning behind the wedding of the decade. From pre-match nerves to Elton John’s florist - learn more about the planning of the most important day of Abbey’s life (and probably Pete’s as well). We also hear how Abbey feels how she has made a load of new friends since starting the podcast and why Peter is still struggling to show his face in the bakery after THAT famous incident. And your favourite Agony Ab is back, helping to navigate the tricky waters of what to do when your girlfriend plans, and pays for, your wedding without your knowledge but on your credit card and how to get out of your sister’s OTT wedding prep.

programme.title: Carol Vorderman Talks Politics, Education, and Parenting
programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

programme.title: Poorna Bell On How To Put Yourself First
programme.desc: Award-winning journalist and author Poorna Bell joins Fearne to talk about ageing, ambition, marriage, motherhood, grief and the quiet rage that can build when women feel invisible. From challenging the narrative that women "disappear" in midlife, to questioning the myth of "having it all", this conversation is about reclaiming agency, on your own terms.

programme.title: Liz Earle On Her Perimenopause And Midlife Reinvention
programme.desc: Broadcaster and healthy ageing expert Liz Earle discusses her transformation from overwhelmed, overweight, and exhausted during perimenopause to thriving in her 60s. She shares the lifestyle shifts that improved her health, including the importance of morning light and circadian rhythms, strength training, sleep, and consistency in wellbeing.

programme.title: Ruby Wax On Why Trump Scares Her!
programme.desc: Have you noticed that your memory and rational thinking disappear when you're anxious? Ruby Wax wants you to retrain your focus and attention in a digital world that's always trying to steal it. In this chat with Fearne – live from the Happy Place Festival – Ruby explains the difference between mental health and mental illness, and why she calls meditation 'mind gym'.

programme.title: Dr Julie on Triggers And Behaviour Patterns
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. She explores why feedback from others can trigger old wounds and how patterns developed in childhood keep replaying in adulthood.

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Zayn Malik's Secret to Slow Living
programme.desc: Musician Zayn talks through the quiet lifestyle he loves in Pennsylvania: painting, being outdoors, spending time with his daughter, and staying off his phone. He explains how fatherhood has changed him, whether he's the parent he thought he would be, and what impact the new depths of emotion he feels has had on his music.

programme.title: Brian Cox’s Guide To Being A True Scot
programme.desc: Brian Cox sets the record straight on what it really means to be Scottish. From authentic Scottish slang to the biggest misconceptions people, especially in America, still get wrong. With sharp wit and no-nonsense honesty, he dives into real Scottish slang and what it actually means, the stereotypes that need binning immediately, the cultural differences that confuse the rest of the world, and a cheeky look at some of America's more baffling takes on Scotland.

programme.title: Big Tech Is Destroying Democracy - Beeban Kidron Interview
programme.desc: Baroness Beeban Kidron, filmmaker and tech campaigner, discusses her book Users: How Big Tech Took Control and How to Fight Back. She breaks down how big tech companies have influenced democracy, warped regulatory structures for their own benefit, and knowingly harmed their users.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: We Quiz FLO On Their Own Songs
programme.desc: FLO go head-to-head in the ultimate JOE Pub Quiz. The girls put their music knowledge to the test in a rapid-fire battle featuring rounds including Guess the Legendary Song from the First 5 Seconds, Do They Know Their Own Song Lyrics and a test of their general music knowledge. Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob - Spider Man Quiz Showdown
programme.desc: Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon go head-to-head in the ultimate Spider-Man pub quiz. These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

programme.title: Old People Try Bizarre Food
programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Keir Starmer’s Weirdest Moments As Prime Minister
programme.desc: Keir Starmer's time in office has come to a close. His legacy includes some strange moments. From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump’s Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational - Football Debate
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.title: The Movie Elimination Quiz
programme.desc: 10 people go head to head in a movie quiz to see who will be the last one standing. If they get one question wrong they have to sit. programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: Melrose Place: En helt ny dag

programme.title: Melrose Place: Den trojanske stork

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ingen tid til sædbanker

programme.title: Melrose Place: Hemmeligheter og koner
programme.desc: Etter at Lexi tar kontroll over Coopers kontoer, beskylder han Michael for å fortelle henne om de skjulte aktivaene.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Let's Make it Official
programme.desc: Jenni lurer på hvordan det går mellom henne og Roger og forstår at de kanskje er verre ute og kjøre enn hun trodde. Mike vil ta forholdet med Paula et skritt videre...til han får virkeligheten i fanget.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Great Meatballs of Fire
programme.desc: Mike prøver å tilpasse seg å være i et forhold, men blir forvirret rundt hvordan reglene egentlig funker. Deena går tilbake til sitt liv som kjøttbolle, men må kjempe med nebb og klør for sine festrettigheter.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Control the Crazy
programme.desc: Sammi konfronterer Deena med hennes kjøttbolleutbrudd og de blir stående og stange. Mike og kompisene blir kjent med Paulas "ville" side, og Mike vet ikke helt om han kan takle det.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Make it Unofficial
programme.desc: Jenni planlegger en babyfest for Nicole og inviterer alle kameratene. Gutta støtter Mike som vil slå opp med Paula, og blir med ham for å oppleve øyeblikket fra første rad.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Shore Shower
programme.desc: MVP er tilbake og muliggjør en nær-trekantopplevelse for Vinny. Gjengen treffer på Angelina i en klubb. Jentene sliter med å holde babyfesten hemmelig for Nicole, og Vinny liker ikke tanken på seg selv og Jionni sammen på babyfesten.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Awkward!
programme.desc: Vinnie prater ut med Jionni og de ordner opp i flokene, så Vin og Nicole kan gjenoppta vennskapet om de vil. Samtidig innser Mike de feilene han har gjort og forsøker å få Nicoles tilgivelse.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Raining Men & Meatballs
programme.desc: Kjøttbollene tar over strandpromenaden og holder audition for å finne en midlertidig festkompis til Deena. Mike avslører at han var stripper før i tiden og romkameratene får ham til å vise sine kunster.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Icing on the Cake
programme.desc: Det er slutten på sommeren, og slutten på en lang reise for romkameratene når de forbereder seg på å ta et siste farvel med Seaside.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Jersey Shore Reunion
programme.desc: Hver sommer kommer tusenvis av unge til Jersey Shore for å delta i østkystens overgangsritual: The Shore House. Jersey Shore viser dette fenomenet.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Cold As Ice
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Dark Side of Paradise

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Letter

programme.title: 48 Hours: Janet's Secret

programme.title: On the Case: Painful Memories

programme.title: On the Case: Last Dance

programme.title: On the Case: Screams for Justice

programme.title: On the Case: Race To Judgment

programme.title: On the Case: A Hole in their Hearts

programme.title: 7 Days In Entebbe
programme.desc: "7 Days in Entebbe", inspirert av sanne begivenheter, skildrer den historiske kapringen av Air France avgang 139 fra Tel Aviv til Paris, og det dristige redningstoktet som fulgte.

programme.title: Lars and The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars er en elskverdig introvert mann med emosjonell bagasje som har hindret ham i å si ja til livet. Etter år av ensomhet inviterer han Bianca, en venn han har møtt på Internett, til å møte ham.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Basert på en sann historie om fire utenforstående som så det de store bankene, media og regjeringen nektet å se: kollapsen av verdensøkonomien. En dristig investering fører dem inn i det mørke indre av banker, hvor alt og alle må stilles spørsmål ved.
